category_title: Socially active preschoolers who use unfriendly tones and comments with peers
minimal_context: Nia is organizing a drawing activity with her friends during a 10-minute free play period in the preschool classroom.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time for our 10-minute free play period. You can go over to the art table and play with your friends.

STUDENT: I'm going to organize the drawing game! Everyone sit down and listen to me.

TUTOR: Go ahead and start your activity.

STUDENT: No, you aren't playing right. Your picture is messy.

TUTOR: Just keep playing together.

STUDENT: Stop! Get out of my way. I can do better than you, let me do that!

options.A: Before free play begins, show Nia a brief 2-minute video clip and discuss how friends respectfully talk to one another, compliment one another, and ask to help each other.
options.B: Tell Nia that she is allowed to play the drawing game with her friends only if she successfully carries out an assigned mission during the free play period.
options.C: After the free play period, ask Nia what she thinks went wrong during the drawing activity with her friends instead of telling her what went wrong.
options.D: Provide follow-in talk that is related to Nia's ongoing actions and attention during the drawing activity with her friends during the free play period.
